Prop := QX26AgenticDelegation.soloThreshold skill mean riskAversion precision activationCost =
    activationCost - skill * mean + riskAversion * skill ^ 2 / (2 * precision) ∧
  QX26AgenticDelegation.copilotThreshold skill mean riskAversion precision activationCost copilotGain copilotCost =
      QX26AgenticDelegation.soloThreshold skill mean riskAversion precision activationCost -
        (copilotGain * skill - copilotCost) ∧
    QX26AgenticDelegation.generationOneThreshold
          (QX26AgenticDelegation.soloThreshold skill mean riskAversion precision activationCost) copilotGain skill
          copilotCost =
        min (QX26AgenticDelegation.soloThreshold skill mean riskAversion precision activationCost)
          (QX26AgenticDelegation.copilotThreshold skill mean riskAversion precision activationCost copilotGain
            copilotCost) ∧
      QX26AgenticDelegation.delegationThreshold skill mean ability capability delegationShare riskAversion precision
            activationCost delegationCost agentCompetence verificationCost residualVariance =
          activationCost - (1 - delegationShare) * skill * mean -
                  delegationShare * ability * agentCompetence capability +
                verificationCost ability skill +
              delegationCost +
            riskAversion / 2 *
              ((1 - delegationShare) ^ 2 * skill ^ 2 / precision + residualVariance ability skill capability) ∧
        QX26AgenticDelegation.generationTwoThreshold
              (QX26AgenticDelegation.generationOneThreshold
                (QX26AgenticDelegation.soloThreshold skill mean riskAversion precision activationCost) copilotGain skill
                copilotCost)
              (QX26AgenticDelegation.delegationThreshold skill mean ability capability delegationShare riskAversion
                precision activationCost delegationCost agentCompetence verificationCost residualVariance) =
            min
              (QX26AgenticDelegation.generationOneThreshold
                (QX26AgenticDelegation.soloThreshold skill mean riskAversion precision activationCost) copilotGain skill
                copilotCost)
              (QX26AgenticDelegation.delegationThreshold skill mean ability capability delegationShare riskAversion
                precision activationCost delegationCost agentCompetence verificationCost residualVariance) ∧
          (copilotGain * skill - copilotCost ≤ 0 →
              QX26AgenticDelegation.generationOneThreshold
                  (QX26AgenticDelegation.soloThreshold skill mean riskAversion precision activationCost) copilotGain
                  skill copilotCost =
                QX26AgenticDelegation.soloThreshold skill mean riskAversion precision activationCost) ∧
            QX26AgenticDelegation.soloThreshold skill mean riskAversion precision activationCost -
                QX26AgenticDelegation.delegationThreshold skill mean ability capability delegationShare riskAversion
                  precision activationCost delegationCost agentCompetence verificationCost residualVariance =
              delegationShare * (ability * agentCompetence capability - skill * mean) - verificationCost ability skill -
                  delegationCost +
                riskAversion / 2 *
                  ((2 * delegationShare - delegationShare ^ 2) * skill ^ 2 / precision -
                    residualVariance ability skill capability)

QX26AgenticDelegation.totalSignalPrecision signals signalVariance = ∑ signal ∈ signals, 1 / signalVariance signal ∧
  QX26AgenticDelegation.precisionWeightedSignalMean signals signalValue signalVariance =
      (∑ signal ∈ signals, signalValue signal / signalVariance signal) /
        QX26AgenticDelegation.totalSignalPrecision signals signalVariance ∧
    QX26AgenticDelegation.posteriorPrecision priorPrecision
          (QX26AgenticDelegation.totalSignalPrecision signals signalVariance) =
        priorPrecision + QX26AgenticDelegation.totalSignalPrecision signals signalVariance ∧
      QX26AgenticDelegation.posteriorMean priorPrecision priorMean
            (QX26AgenticDelegation.totalSignalPrecision signals signalVariance)
            (QX26AgenticDelegation.precisionWeightedSignalMean signals signalValue signalVariance) =
          (priorPrecision * priorMean +
              QX26AgenticDelegation.totalSignalPrecision signals signalVariance *
                QX26AgenticDelegation.precisionWeightedSignalMean signals signalValue signalVariance) /
            (priorPrecision + QX26AgenticDelegation.totalSignalPrecision signals signalVariance) ∧
        priorPrecision <
          QX26AgenticDelegation.posteriorPrecision priorPrecision
            (QX26AgenticDelegation.totalSignalPrecision signals signalVariance)

Prop := ∀ {Signal : Type u_1} (signals : Finset Signal) (signalValue signalVariance : Signal → ℝ)
  (priorPrecision priorMean : ℝ),
  signals.Nonempty →
    (∀ signal ∈ signals, 0 < signalVariance signal) →
      have signalPrecision := QX26AgenticDelegation.totalSignalPrecision signals signalVariance;
      have weightedSignalMean := QX26AgenticDelegation.precisionWeightedSignalMean signals signalValue signalVariance;
      signalPrecision = ∑ signal ∈ signals, 1 / signalVariance signal ∧
        weightedSignalMean = (∑ signal ∈ signals, signalValue signal / signalVariance signal) / signalPrecision ∧
          QX26AgenticDelegation.posteriorPrecision priorPrecision signalPrecision = priorPrecision + signalPrecision ∧
            QX26AgenticDelegation.posteriorMean priorPrecision priorMean signalPrecision weightedSignalMean =
                (priorPrecision * priorMean + signalPrecision * weightedSignalMean) /
                  (priorPrecision + signalPrecision) ∧
              priorPrecision < QX26AgenticDelegation.posteriorPrecision priorPrecision signalPrecision
